policy_api: transition(current_state: str, event: str) -> str | None
priority_scope: events recognized in the same scheduler tick

checker_contracts.baseline: fixed baseline mapping specified in README
checker_contracts.group: positive inputs choose interested/happy; safety/recovery fixed; all states reachable

motion_detection_rule: absolute change in any actually applied joint strictly greater than motion_detection_rad
latency_origin: original source interaction timestamp, retained before debounce
source_latency: earliest motion/RGB across candidates sharing input_id and kind
event_latency: first actual applied pose/RGB change attributed to one candidate event
both_onset: max(motion onset, RGB onset) when both exist; otherwise unavailable
measurement_scope: synthetic command onset; no physical device measurement
learning: none: fixed rules, mappings and parameters
